name: Sachin Marwade
review: My MERN project only ever ran on localhost. In this training I deployed it to a cloud server with my own domain and HTTPS, and now I can explain every step of the deployment in interviews.

name: Faizal Khan
review: Setting up Nginx, the process manager and the SSL certificate step by step finally made deployment click for me. Fixing the errors on my own project, live with the trainer, was the most useful part.

name: Inder
review: I used to copy deployment commands from videos without knowing what they did. Here every command was explained, so when something breaks on the server I know where to look and how to fix it.

name: Shayan
review: I had never worked on a Linux server before. Now my college project is live on its own domain, connected to a production database, and I know how to keep it running.

name: Ajay Kalastri
review: I only knew how to run npm start. Now I can build my React app for production, serve it with Nginx and point my own domain at it. The step-by-step sessions made it simple to follow.

name: Arvind Kumar
review: My Node.js API kept stopping whenever I closed the terminal. Learning to run it with a process manager behind a reverse proxy fixed that, and now I understand what is happening on the server.

name: Sanjay Kokde
review: I used to hand client projects over as zip files. After this training I deploy them on the client's own server with HTTPS, which makes my work look far more professional.
